settings.title: Settings
settings.flashcardFrontSideDesc: Show answer options on the front of the flashcard (multiple-choice style). Turn off to show only the question for pure recall practice.

emailSection.title: Email Notifications
emailSection.desc: Control how email notifications are sent and received when sharing decks.
emailSection.receiveLabel: Receive email when someone shares a deck with me
emailSection.receiveDesc: When enabled, you will receive an email notification whenever someone invites you to view their deck.
emailSection.sendLabel: Send email to recipients when I share a deck
emailSection.sendDesc: When enabled, the people you share with will receive an email (if they also allow it).
emailSection.sendNote: Recipient preference takes priority — email is only sent when both parties have their toggle on.
emailSection.infoBox: Email is sent only when: the sender has "Send email" on AND the recipient has "Receive email" on.

apiKeysSection.title: Gemini API Keys
apiKeysSection.desc: Manage the API keys used by the AI Scan feature. Keys are stored securely in your Google Drive.

decksSection.title: My Decks
decksSection.resetDesc: All study progress (Known/Unknown) will be reset to 0. This cannot be undone.
decksSection.deleteDesc: {{count}} card(s) will be permanently lost. This action cannot be undone.

dangerSection.title: Danger Zone
dangerSection.desc: Actions in this section cannot be undone. Be absolutely sure before proceeding.
dangerSection.deleteAllDesc: Permanently delete all your decks and study progress across all platforms. Your account remains but will be completely empty.

nuclearModal.title: Delete All Data?
nuclearModal.item1: All your flashcard decks and cards
nuclearModal.item2: All study progress across all devices

nuclearModal.typePhrase: I know this cannot be undone

common.discardChangesDesc: Are you sure you want to discard your changes? All input data will be lost.
common.abortCreationDesc: Are you sure you want to abort creating this deck? All input will be lost.
common.resetProgressDesc: Are you sure you want to reset all progress? This action cannot be undone.
